verses.1: Prayer for David: May Jehovah hear me, O righteous one. I will listen carefully to your prayers. My prayer is sincere, without any deceitful words.
verses.2: From before you, my judgment has been revealed; your eyes shall see what is right.
verses.3: You have filled my heart with sorrow. You have troubled me all night, making it impossible for me to find any time to rest.
verses.4: In what people do with your words, I have kept their promises.
verses.5: Within you, I will dwell in your curves, without being lost.
verses.6: I call you, so that you may answer me. Please listen to my words with your ear.
verses.7: May your mercy be a liberator from those who are in need of redemption, in your right hand.
verses.8: Protect me as a child in a prison, with the shadow of your wings, so that you may hide me from harm.
verses.9: Because of the wicked, this is a time of suffering and hardship. They will surround me with their evil actions.
verses.10: They sealed him up; they spoke in a manner that was disrespectful.
verses.11: Let us now humble ourselves; let our eyes be turned toward the ground.
verses.12: Dymion is like a lion, hidden away to hunt and strike at his prey. He sits in hiding, in secret places.
verses.13: May the Lord come forward, with His face facing us. May He destroy your evil plans from within you.
verses.14: From the very beginning, LORD, from everlasting, they will be part of life. Their offspring will multiply, and they will be blessed in their children.
verses.15: I truly hold your face in my hands, and I will praise you with all my heart.
